one_sentence_story: A ten-minute afternoon nap wakes you up sharp for over two hours because it stops right before your brain sinks into heavy deep-sleep waves at thirty minutes.
so_what_for_you: When a short night catches up with you before 3:30 PM, set a fourteen-minute phone timer so you get ten minutes of light sleep and zero groggy hangover.
